image_description: A side-profile view of a wood rabbit (cottontail) sitting on sandy ground in front of dry, greyish brush. The rabbit has speckled grey-brown fur, large dark eyes, and upright ears with dark tips. Its white fluffy tail is visible at the rear. The forelegs are tucked under the chest, and the hind legs are partially visible but mostly obscured by the body angle.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The body shape is compact and rounded, fitting the description of a cottontail rabbit.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is short, fluffy, and distinctly white, which is the defining characteristic of the cottontail rabbit.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The forelegs are tucked beneath the chest and obscured by fur and shadow. Digits and claws are not visible.
